# REACTOR

Launch. Reflect. Burn. Token launchpad for Arc.

Official REACTOR pools are Uniswap v4 markets with a 0% LP fee and a 3.5% quote-side protocol charge (2% holders / 1% Top-10 / 0.5% CORE buy+burn). Protocol 0.2.0. Factory V1. Not audited. No public mainnet.

## Honesty
Do not claim the protocol is audited or trustless. Top-10 ranks are an offchain API. Contracts check structure only. CHALLENGE is not ALLOW. The launch signer is not public. Mainnet is blocked pending Codex + audits + KMS/Safe rehearsal.
